description: This file defines the HomePage component for an Ionic/Angular taxi booking web admin app. It manages map interactions, user authentication, ride requests, driver matching, and payment processing.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: Main component for the home page of the taxi booking admin app, handling map, ride requests, driver matching, and payments.

methods.name: ionViewDidLoad
methods.description: Initializes the page, checks user authentication, loads map, and sets up geolocation.

methods.name: WaitForGeolocation
methods.description: Waits until the map has shown the user's location before proceeding.

methods.name: toggleMoreBtn
methods.description: Toggles the display of additional options.

methods.name: callDriver
methods.description: Initiates a phone call to the driver.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the driver.

methods.name: showMap
methods.description: Displays the map with current location.

methods.name: showAddressModal
methods.description: Opens modal for address autocomplete and handles selection.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Calculates route and estimates trip.

methods.name: CheckForPreviousData
methods.description: Checks for existing user data and initiates ride request if available.

methods.name: pickLocation
methods.description: Displays location picker.

methods.name: hideFunctions
methods.description: Hides UI elements related to active ride.

methods.name: StartListeningForChanges
methods.description: Sets up real-time Firebase listeners for ride status updates.

methods.name: cancelRequest
methods.description: Cancels current ride request.

methods.name: gotoPayment
methods.description: Navigates to payment page.

methods.name: createUserInformation
methods.description: Creates or updates user info in Firebase and initiates ride request.

methods.name: CreatePushNotification
methods.description: Sends push notification to driver.

methods.name: ClearInformation
methods.description: Clears current ride data and resets for new request.

methods.name: startWaitingForResponse
methods.description: Waits for driver response and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: showPayCash
methods.description: Displays alert for cash payment setup.

methods.name: hideFunctionsOnDriverFound
methods.description: Adjusts UI after driver is found.

methods.name: DriverFound
methods.description: Handles driver info and map marker setup upon driver assignment.

methods.name: ChargeCard
methods.description: Processes card payment via Paystack plugin.

methods.name: showPayAlert
methods.description: Displays payment charge alert.

methods.name: showPayMentErrorAlert
methods.description: Displays error alert for payment issues.

methods.name: presentRouteLoader
methods.description: Shows loading indicator with message.
